title: 菊花賞の後に・秋晴れの下で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek has gotten her racing groove back and smiles, knowing that she's able to race vigorously once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she is unable to win the Kikuka Sho, she has learned a lot through the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She leaves the Classics behind and we decide to tackle the Nakayama racecourse winter race—the Arima Kinen!
